source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules 1.39: the mode a room plays (docs/design/survival-spec.md section 8.1, Leon's lobby sketch, 13 Nov 2026). A room picks one of these in its lobby (`settings.play`). The lock is this file: `available: true` opens a card; unlocking a mode is one edit, like a campaign's `listed`.
loadout_note: Rules 1.52 (Leon, 14 Nov 2026): a character is a person; what it carries is given by the mode when play starts (each item's `loadout`).

items.name: Survival
items.line: Fight from tile to tile: shops, rests, a Boss each stage. Solo or co-op, no Narrator needed.

loadout.about: Rules 1.52: each character builds its loadout at the camp before node 1 (data/survival.json loadout).

items.name: Roguelike
items.line: Dungeons, a world map and companions.

loadout.about: Rules 1.52: as Survival's camp, until the roguelike has its own.

items.name: Campaign
items.line: A written story with a Narrator.

loadout.about: Rules 1.52: a campaign gives each character its starting gear when the session starts (or when a character joins mid-session): the campaign's own `loadout` when it names one (same shape), else this. A fixed default built from the old creation kits (engine character.ts KITS), chosen by the door skill with most points (by_door, in this order; a tie goes to the first), else `default`. A call for Leon (PROVISIONAL): campaigns name their own loadouts when they are rewritten. The Proving Ground gives the same to a character that comes to it with nothing.
